theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+3.47%) and Technology (+2.09%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.38%) and Utilities (-1.15%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.12% versus -0.48% for defensives and -0.61% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +2.05% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.58%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.54%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 1.35% to 15.01, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.40% to $4,378.40, crude oil was little changed at $91.97, and bitcoin gained 5.88% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
